Definition: from G1223 and G3306; to stay constantly (in being or relation):--continue, remain.
BiblicalUsage: To remain is to stay when everything else passes away, and the word is used of the faithful and the fading alike. The disciples remain with Jesus in His temptations, the gospel remains with the Galatians, the heavens and the earth will pass away while Christ remains, and the scoffers ask where the promise of His coming is.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe remaining is the whole of the Christian life. Temptations come, the world scoffs, and heaven and earth themselves will change, but Christ remains, and those who remain in Him remain forever.
